verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a spreadsheet or CSV import feature with field mapping, validation, or row-level error reporting for contacts and deals. The only nearby items are Web API primitives (POST create, batch change sets) and Excel export, which are developer building blocks or the opposite direction and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can import my spreadsheet of contacts and deals with field mapping and validation, without losing rows silently
